caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher designed to resemble an ear of corn standing upright. The central body of the pitcher is yellow with a textured pattern mimicking the kernels of corn. Green leaves wrap around the base and sides of the pitcher, forming the handle and adding additional decorative elements. The upper rim of the pitcher is colored pinkish-brown, indicating the interior or the tip of the corn. The background is plain, with the object centered on an off-white or beige surface. There are no other objects or patterns in the drawing.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
